name: Carmilla: Sanguis et Amor
source:
When a vampire slowly twists a girls heart to her whims, what's a girl to do?

This is the tale of Laura, a Victorian young woman living in a castle in Styria, when she and her father take in an unexpected guest, the beautiful and languid Carmilla. Little do either of them know, Carmilla will be the undoing of their sanity and their lives.

[From [url=https://mechanika-charlotte.itch.io/carmilla-sanguis-et-amor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当吸血鬼慢慢地扭曲女孩的心，让她随心所欲时，女孩该怎么办？

这是关于劳拉的故事，她是一位维多利亚时代的年轻女子，住在施泰尔马克州的一座城堡里，她和她的父亲接待了一位不速之客，美丽而慵懒的卡米拉。他们谁都不知道，卡米拉将毁掉他们的理智和生活。

[来自[url=https://mechanika-charlotte.itch.io/carmilla-sanguis-et-amor]itch.io[/url]]
